mod.touhou_maid_affection.name: Touhou Maid: Affection
mod.touhou_maid_affection.description: Kiss your maid! Adds affectionate interactions to Touhou Little Maid.

tips.touhou_maid_affection.offhand_tempt: Holding temptation items (default: cake) in offhand also attracts maids

bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.morning.1: %s rises on her toes: Good morning, Master. Let me steal the first kiss of the day and stay by your side.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.morning.2: %s whispers near your ear: I want to quietly give the first piece of today's affection to you, Master.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.morning.3: %s blushes softly: Your presence is so comforting... let me come a little closer.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.morning.4: %s smiles gently: Think of this kiss as today's little good-luck charm, and don't you dare dodge it.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.morning.5: %s looks at you tenderly: Good morning, Master... I want to leave my longing right on your lips.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.morning.6: %s murmurs sweetly: If I kiss you now, the whole day is bound to feel softer.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.evening.1: %s lowers her voice: Master, the day is winding down, so let me end it with a kiss.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.evening.2: %s leans close: You worked hard today, Master... may I steal a good-night kiss?
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.evening.3: %s gazes at you softly: The night feels so gentle right now. I only want to leave you with a warm kiss.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.evening.4: %s tugs lightly at your sleeve: Before the night grows deeper, please let me come a little closer.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.evening.5: %s smiles with sleepy warmth: Then take this good-night kiss, and promise you'll rest well for me.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.evening.6: %s whispers by your ear: If this kiss helps you sleep peacefully, I'll be more than happy.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.general.1: %s leans in carefully: Please stay still, Master. I want to hand you the gentlest part of my heart.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.general.2: %s blinks at you: I've been holding back for a while, so now it's my turn to steal a kiss.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.general.3: %s speaks in a tiny voice: Being this close to you makes my heart flutter every time.
bond.morning_kiss.dialogue.general.4: %s moves closer with a warm smile: Master, let this kiss be my most honest confession right now.
bond.random_gift.desc.auto: After unlocking, the maid prepares one gift every so often in real time. Gifts are queued while away, up to 7.
